sections.heading: 1. Seated rotation
lines: ① Sit tall, hands resting on your shoulders.
② Slowly turn side to side, 10 times.
③ Repeat once an hour — set a reminder.
④ Keep a 2-week headache diary (sleep, water).

sections.heading: 2. See your GP promptly if…
lines: A sudden, severe headache, one after a knock,
or fever, vision changes or numbness come with it.

caption:
Deadline week, and Mr Turtle's head feels like it's wrapped in a rubber band, with an upper back like concrete.

Tension-type headaches are common, and many people notice tender muscles across the shoulders, upper back and base of the skull when they flare. Poor sleep, stress, skipped meals, not enough water and long screen sessions often play a part.

Hybi's tip: hands on shoulders, turn slowly side to side 10 times, once an hour. A two-week headache diary can show patterns you can change.

A sudden severe headache, one after a knock to the head, or headaches with fever, vision changes or numbness need your GP promptly. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio assess the neck and upper back. Book online via the link in bio.
